rules.title: How to play
rules.r1: Put your finger (or the mouse) on the ball and swipe towards where you want to hit: the overall direction of the swipe is your target. Only the trace you draw is shown; you judge where the ball will go.
rules.r2: Power comes from the fastest moment of your swipe: swipe fast and the shot is hard enough to beat the keeper. The yellow end of the bar is too weak, the red end is too strong (the ball balloons). Hard shots stray more, and a shaky swipe adds a little scatter.
rules.r3: For curl, draw a curved path: a path bulging to the right sends the ball out right and curls it left, around the wall. A gentle curve is enough; a straight line is a straight shot.
rules.r4: Each series has 5 shots; the ball position and the wall change every shot. The keeper stays put until you shoot, then dives towards their guess (late and error-prone at low levels, fast and accurate at high ones). The first 2 shots are easier.
rules.r5: Level mode (free kick of the day): 3 lives, one shot per level. Goal → next level, miss → lose a life. Distance and angle grow every level (from 20 m central to 32 m wide; see "Distance" above the pitch); the wall, keeper, wind (direction and strength shown above the pitch), a narrower goal and a moving wall arrive step by step. Everyone plays the same sequence that day.
rules.p4: In level mode points are multiplied by the level: level 1 ×1, level 2 ×1.5, level 3 ×2 … Ranking is by level reached first, then points.

tip.title: How to play
tip.l1: Swipe from the ball towards the goal: the swipe direction is your target, and only your trace is shown.
tip.l2: Swipe fast for a hard shot. Stay in the green zone of the bar; in the red the ball balloons.
tip.l3: Draw a curved path and the ball curls around the wall. Hard shots stray more.
tip.l4: Level mode: 3 lives. Watch the wind arrow; if it points right, the ball drifts right.
